Federal agencies remain active in threat intelligence dissemination, with the FBI IC3 releasing timely advisories that defenders should incorporate into their monitoring.
NIST continues to advance standards relevant to emerging technology, with new draft publications signaling upcoming compliance and best practice guidance.
